content.heading: Appeals from convictions
content.text: Any person convicted on a trial held by a High Court in its extraordinary original criminal jurisdiction may appeal to the Supreme Court. Any person convicted on a trial held by a Sessions Judge or an Additional Sessions Judge may appeal to the High Court. Any person convicted on a trial held by any other Court may appeal to the Court of Session, subject to the enacted exceptions. This is the successor of CrPC 374. Read the official text.
